title: HealthSync – AI-Powered Healthcare System
author: Asinu Kumarage
overview: HealthSync is a microservices-based healthcare platform designed to connect patients, doctors, and payments seamlessly. Featuring AI-powered diagnostic suggestions and automated appointment scheduling, it provides a comprehensive digital clinic experience.
keyFeatures: **Microservices architecture** dividing business logic into Authentication, Patient management, and Payment processing services
**Stripe integration** offering a secure and sandboxed billing flow for doctors and clinic appointments
**AI Symptom checker** leveraging Gemini models to give quick insights on patient symptoms before doctor review
**MongoDB databases** with service-specific instances to prevent service coupling and ensure isolation
**Automated notification indicators** with a real-time polling mechanism in the navbar for unread patient updates
